_doc: LAYOUT_POKE_MART (11x8): Sapphire's Poké Mart. Rows 0-1 back wall (clock at (1,0)); row 1 = shop shelves along the wall: glass-front coolers (3-5) and two goods shelves (6-7, 8-9); glass counter: (2,1)-(2,4) and (0,4)-(1,4) with the register at (2,2), the clerk at (1,3) behind it; goods shelf block (6-7, 4-6); goods shelf against the east wall (10, 4-6); plant (10,3); exit mat (3-4, 7). Black 2 pieces: Shopping Mall Nine floor/wall (style "shop"), its red entrance mat in45_mat01; glass counter = shelf03 (the display counter of Black 2's Pokémon Center mart, chunk 827) with cashier01; goods shelves = pcshelf01 (the Center mart's goods shelf); coolers = in_vender01 (glass-front drinks machine, one tile); clock = the pendulum clock picture in69_clock01 (texture set 350) as in Brendan's room.
